scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && pnpm -r typecheck && pnpm typecheck:deno
scripts.typecheck:deno: deno check --config supabase/functions/deno.json supabase/functions scripts/mock-pluggy.ts && deno lint --config supabase/functions/deno.json supabase/functions scripts/mock-pluggy.ts
scripts.test:db: supabase db reset && supabase test db && scripts/test-int.sh
scripts.test:fn: rm -rf coverage/fn && deno test -A --config supabase/functions/deno.json --coverage=coverage/fn supabase/functions && deno coverage coverage/fn --lcov --output=coverage/fn.lcov && node scripts/check-fn-coverage.ts coverage/fn.lcov
scripts.verify: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm vendor --check && pnpm test && pnpm build
scripts.ci:lint-types: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm vendor --check && node scripts/ci-greps.ts && pnpm audit --prod --audit-level=high
scripts.ci:db: pnpm test:db && supabase db lint --level error --fail-on error && scripts/gen-db-types.sh --check
scripts.ci:local: pnpm ci:guard && pnpm ci:secrets && pnpm ci:lint-types && pnpm ci:unit && pnpm ci:db && pnpm ci:fn && pnpm ci:e2e && pnpm ci:build
